correctness.rationale: PASS: In nonsmooth coordinate w=z+|x|y, H=xw-y²/2 is a smooth first integral; H=-h is a smooth hyperboloid cylinder without equilibria and x=0 seam forces y²=2h>0, so all crossings transverse. One-sided leaf divergence equals -|x| and seam normal speeds coincide; area-flux Stokes excludes a contractible cycle and an annulus between two essential cycles. Theorem 1 of Llibre–Novaes–Valls (2023) supplies existence on each negative-energy level, hence uniqueness. Saltation jump has zero x component, determinant1; monodromy determinant equals exp(-∫|x|dt), and time-shift plus first integral give the two unit multipliers. Weight (1,2,3) scaling yields energy-independent rho and T_h=h^-1/4 T_1; odd symmetry forces half-period central inversion. Planar crossing Poincaré–Bendixson gives bounded basin. Independently checked exact branch H conservation, divergence and saltation shear; finite algebra alone does not prove global cycle existence or uniqueness.
